records.section: G4-N · "FOURTEEN: LIVE" — the campaign bible (the FOURTEEN duology, part 2) / 1 · Premise
records.requirementOrFinding: > **One year after going live honestly, the FOURTEEN crew films the biggest thing that ever happened to their school — a fully paid class trip, destination by student vote: Dublin, New York or Sydney. Then Leo's camera catches a poster that says the winner before the vote begins.** What starts as the channel's first real outside broadcast becomes their first investigation: favors, a sponsor, a teacher they like — and the hardest question of Season 2: *not* "who did it?", but **"how do you tell the truth so it makes things better, not worse?"**

records.requirementOrFinding: G3 ends on the bridge (ch14: *"No script … They go live. It is messy. It is honest."*). Season 2 cashes it: the crew that stopped scripting now points the camera at the world — and learns that live honesty has rules, costs, and power. Where G3 was about what the internet does to a friend, **G4 is about what the truth does to a community** — and that the teller chooses how it lands.
